scripts.build: rm -rf dist plugin && tsc --project tsconfig-build.json && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:plugin
scripts.build:api: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml && wasm-bindgen target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/relyzer_swc.wasm --out-dir dist/wasm --target nodejs
scripts.build:plugin: mkdir -p plugin && cargo build --target wasm32-wasi --release --manifest-path Cargo.toml && cp target/wasm32-wasi/release/relyzer_swc.wasm plugin/relyzer_swc.wasm
